title: Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future

On November 10, 2026, President Nayib Bukele hosted roughly 30 Bitcoiners at Casa Presidencial during Bitcoin Histórico. Guests included Ricardo Salinas Pliego, Parker Lewis, Mike Peterson, and miners; discussions covered power generation for compute and immigration.

This post Inside Bukele’s Casa Presidencial Dinner: Bitcoiners Discuss Energy, Immigration, and El Salvador’s Future first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt.

title: Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides

Strategy shares fell 4.6% to $86.13 on Thursday, their sixth straight decline, as bitcoin dipped below $62,000. The company's 850,849 BTC are now worth about $11 billion less than it paid.

This post Strategy (MSTR) Shares Tumble for Sixth Straight Day to $86 as Bitcoin Slides first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam

The SEC charged eight Colorado-based entities, likely run from overseas, with taking more than $37 million from U.S. investors through fake advisers, fake crypto trading platforms and fake SEC certificates.

This post SEC Charges Eight Colorado Firms in $37 Million Fake Crypto Platform Scam first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
